name: Station Readiness
author: yock
description: Station readiness for digital-mode operators: time sync, CAT control, radio audio and TNC transport at a glance, with a green/amber/red bar indicator.

barWidget.description: Green/amber/red station readiness: time sync, CAT, radio audio and TNC transport.

schema.label: Readiness refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the time source, CAT link and TNC transport are probed. Radio audio and Bluetooth state update live.

schema.label: GPS mode
schema.description: Off: no GPS, NTP is enough. Optional: GPS is configured, so losing it warns but a fix without PPS or an unselected fix stays green. Required: losing it, a fix without PPS or an unselected fix all warn.

schema.label: Station paths
schema.description: Host audio: CAT control and radio audio over the host's soundcard. TNC: a modem carries the audio and keys the rig, so only its transport is graded and CAT and radio audio are not applicable. Both: every declared path must be ready.

schema.label: TNC transport
schema.description: The modem's transport: an absolute serial device path such as /dev/ttyACM0, or a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Classified by shape and graded on holdership, never on a KISS dialogue.
